reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: Cannot get into the app. I entered all my information, clicked on the link to validate my email, but it sends me right back to the page that says “check your email”. I tried two different times in two different browsers. Circular trap.

reviews.title: Completely broken
reviews.text: Email sign up link doesn’t work at all, just loads back into the app still telling me to verify my email. The fact that account creation isn’t allowed on the website to circumvent this problem is ridiculous. Extremely frustrating.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Phone apps should never log out, especially if they have needlessly complex password requirements like this one does

reviews.title: Software is written for Phones
reviews.text: I use my iPad for most all of my internet work. This program is set-up for use on a phone in portrait mode. I use a keyboard  with my iPad so my screen is in Landscape mode all of the time. When I run across programs like this it requires me to read the screen on its side… Pain in the Arse! Other programs allow for using my pad… I cannot get the program to download and setup at all…The installer does a lot of bouncing around and then doesn’t work…

reviews.title: Account Creation Broken
reviews.text:
Account verification completely broken. The verify link takes you to a page to copy an image which when you click that it brings you back to download the app. 

Was never able to get it to work.

reviews.title: My cat Noah
reviews.text: Noah has not been feeling well for 2-3 months. He’s been drinking more water than usual. So I knew he needed looked at especially since he is at least 14. They helped me get an appointment for a sooner time and they made Noah feel comfortable about being there. We now know he has chronic kidney disease. They were nice enough to answer some questions about his condition and how to handle it. They are very nice people and helpful in any way they can.

reviews.title: Won’t let me set up an account as the email verification is circular
reviews.text: Boooooo

reviews.title: Unable to create an account
reviews.text: Jump through all the hoops to make an account, including the email verify, and it just goes into a continuous loop of verifying email and unable to create the account.  Having worked with computers for 60 years I should be able to handle this, but this app is totally frustrating.

reviews.title: Cant Verify Email
reviews.text: I have tried closing the app first, restarting my phone, restarting browser, and multiple email links. The link to the app that the email sends does nothing but open the app

reviews.title: Disappointing initial experience.
reviews.text:
First the app requires I use my iPad in portrait mode. Using the iPad in portrait mode over stresses my hand. 

Second the email address confirmation process keeps sending me to the App Store to download the app again and does not confirm my email address.

Pretty poor UX design and quality assurance in my opinion.

reviews.title: Does not deliver
reviews.text: PetDesk claims to be a place where you can see your pets veterinary records and yet there is no place in the app for that. You can’t see the history of reminders that were sent to you about your Pet needing a vaccine or something, but actual records are nonexistent. When test results are in and you go to PetDesk to see those lab results more often than not it just says pending even when the results have been in and the doctor has them and talked to you about them. If you wanna go back and look at the history, there’s nothing there. I find PetDesk to be essentially useless.

reviews.title: Let’s sell insurance
reviews.text:
I thought this was to interface with my vet. But no! The main page is all about selling pet insurance. 
Wellness articles… none on staying fit or managing diet. But 2 justifying pet insurance. 
And no way to turn it off. 
When you finally, after multiple clicks, get to your pet’s page.. the first thing you see is : 
A price for pet insurance. 
So far have not found any vaccine or license details. Did find appointment history. 

So what i need is not there
And what i do not want is everywhere..

reviews.title: Why 5 stars?
reviews.text:
I’m not sure why anyone gave it Five stars when it’s one of the worst apps I’ve ever used. It’s telling me my dog should have had certain immunizations on dates that were before he was even born in red and there’s no way to check the ones that he has had. The ones he has had just have a red exclamation point next to them as if they still needed to be done. Some of this may be the fault of the vets office but there doesn’t seem to be any way to clear it up. There’s no way for me to update his weight. There’s no way for me to make the necessary corrections. There should be a place to say he had a visit on this date with a list of what  immunizations he received. The dates they give us for our next appointment are after the dates he’s supposed to receive his next shots and so I get the red alert saying he’s past due and it stays there indefinitely. This is the worst way to keep track of my dog’s health. I’d rather go back to the handwritten record that you carry around with you than to deal with this app. I find it clumsy and frustrating and confusing because there is no way to correct any of the mistakes.
😩 this app needs a serious overhaul or the office staff at my vets place need a lesson on using the app.

reviews.title: Doesn’t support multiple pet parents!!!
reviews.text: The only way to allow for multiple pet parents is for one user to login to the app with the others credentials. This is a workaround not a feature and it poses security risk to the main user. This widens the care gap because it incentivizes couples to put all the invisible labor of caring for the pet/s on one person. There’s no way for the app to even allow for multiple email addresses to be added so that emails can AT THE VERY LEAST go to both caregivers. This is very poor app design, please do better.

reviews.title: PetDesk
reviews.text:
I’m not sure how to use this. It appears that I’ve already enrolled. Does Molly’s $250.00 count towards points. Please advise
Thank you,
Doreen Wheland

reviews.title: Absolutely stupid sign up
reviews.text: Devs WTF!!?? I need to validate my email but when I send the validation email, I receive a marketing email to sign up instead. Same email I use at my vet. When I click the link in the email I go back to the app and to square one, sign up, validate your email and bam the marketing email to download the app and join.

reviews.title: Can’t sign up - PLEASE FIX
reviews.text:
I have tried multiple times to set up an account and you can’t! 

After providing your information it takes you to a landing page that says “Follow instructions sent your email to validate/finish setting up your account”. 

The email sent is titled “How to know when your pets need care” and offers no option to validate anything or finish signing up. 

“We love having you as a client!  To say thank you, we've got a new mobile app for you and your animal companions.  

Plus:
Request Appointments 24/7
Pet Pickup Notifications
Create and store all your pets' reminders

Just follow these steps on your Apple or Android device:

1. Download PetDesk App
2. Sign up using your email address
3. Verify your info and pet info in the app” 

So you’re back at square one in a never ending loop with no fix available! Cool!

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: This app is horrible! I literally downloaded the app and it is suppose to send me a email to validate my email and account instead it continues to send me emails to DOWNLOAD THE APP! Like I LITERALLY CREATED A PROFILE THROUGH THE APP! I DONT NEED TO DOWNLOAD SOMETHING THAT IS ALREADY DOWNLOADED! JUST SEND ME THE DANG ON EMAIL VALIDATION SO I CAN ACTUALLY USE THE FREAKING APP

reviews.title: Can’t even finish creating account
reviews.text: I tried signing up for an account and it sent an email to validate my email. Issue is the email sent isn’t a email to validate my email.  It just tells me that there is a new app and to download it sign up under my email and verify pet info. Issue is the new app is the same app and this app has a content pop up of saying to go validate my email. I even tried deleting this app then clicking on the download link in the email and it’s this same app!  And as soon as I open it they pop up is back saying to go validate my email.  lol. What the heck!  Deserves 0 stars because you can’t even use it.

reviews.title: DATA MINING SCAM
reviews.text: I have driven my pet 2 hours to the vet to get denied because we did not have an appointment. This app is probably a data mining scam.

reviews.title: Ads make this unusable
reviews.text:
I was very happy using this to keep track of the frequency of vomiting and hairballs for my two cats.

At some point, they switched to full-page ads that you are forced to watch before being able to use the app at all, and most of the time even after the ad finishes you can't close it and are locked out of the app.

I was tolerating it until they added a fantasy AI app to their ad rotation. Sorry, but I'm not interested in having to watch a fake woman spread her legs over and over when I'm just trying to track cat puke. 🙄

reviews.title: Hides the Logout feature
reviews.text: The vet sent me an email to sign up for this.  It may be great but it is a little freaky that they hide the sign out feature because they want you to stay signed in.  Had to search the FAQs to locate the sign out steps.

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: I was using this app for all of my pets and it kept ‘most’ of their information up to date. It was a useful tool until I moved and switched vet clinics. As soon as I had my pets records sent to the new clinic in our new neighborhood everything on pet desk was deleted. Also it was within 24 hr one of my cats had passed and they had completely deleted his profile. Horrible.
